name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
summary: A central sector scheme that provides income support to eligible landholding farmer families, subject to the scheme's rules and exclusions.
who_may_benefit: Landholding farmer families who meet the scheme rules
Applicants whose land and identity records can be verified
eligibility_notes: Eligibility depends on land records and scheme exclusions.
Some categories of higher-income or office-holding individuals may be excluded; check the current official rules.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: A crop insurance scheme intended to help eligible farmers manage specified crop-loss risks, subject to notified crops, areas, seasons, and current enrollment rules.
who_may_benefit: Farmers growing crops notified for coverage in their area and season
Farmers who meet the current enrollment and land/tenancy requirements
eligibility_notes: Availability depends on the state, district, crop, season, and current notification.
Enrollment windows and required documents can change; verify them on the official portal.
documents_to_check: Land records or valid tenancy/cultivation documents, as applicable

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
summary: A credit facility intended to support eligible farmers' agricultural and related credit needs through participating banks.
who_may_benefit: Eligible farmers and other categories permitted under current KCC guidelines
Applicants who meet the lending bank's documentation and credit assessment requirements
eligibility_notes: Final approval, credit limit, and terms are decided by the bank under applicable guidelines.
Ask the participating bank for its current application form and document list.
documents_to_check: Photograph, if requested by the bank
source_label: MyScheme official government scheme directory (search for Kisan Credit Card)

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
summary: A publicly funded health assurance scheme for eligible families, subject to the scheme's current eligibility rules and implementation details.
who_may_benefit: Families/persons identified as eligible under current PM-JAY rules
Applicants whose eligibility can be confirmed through official channels
eligibility_notes: Do not assume eligibility from income or occupation alone.
Check the official portal or an authorized help desk to confirm current eligibility and available benefits.
documents_to_check: Any eligibility/family identification details requested by the official process
Supporting documents requested by an authorized help desk

name: PM Vishwakarma
summary: A central scheme supporting eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople in notified trades through a package of support, subject to current scheme rules.
who_may_benefit: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working in a notified trade
Applicants who meet current age, trade, family, and other scheme conditions
eligibility_notes: The notified trade list and exclusions matter; review the current official guidelines.
Registration or application does not guarantee approval or benefits.
documents_to_check: Any documents requested during official verification
